project.name: System Master Foundation Work Packages
project.description:
Canonical build definition for the foundation work packages F-WP-001..012 (org.systemmaster.core). Replaces the hand-typed javac source lists that were previously embedded in .github/scripts/fwp*-qualify.js.
All work-package sources share a single package and compile as one unit, which is why sourceDirectory is the shared root rather than a per-package module. The qualification test classes are plain main()-based entry points, not JUnit suites, so they are compiled alongside the production sources and executed directly by the qualify scripts. There is no surefire phase to bind them to.
